text:
InfraPager: ALERT: Dedicated pool `dedicated-eu-1` GPU utilization >95% for 7m, request error-rate spiking ~12% (5xx). Auto-scaler hasn't added capacity. Paging Aisha (oncall) now. Incident: INC-2026-042 :rotating_light:

Aisha (oncall): Acked. Looking. Any customer-facing impact reported?

Priya (SRE): We're seeing 503s and >2s tail latency for generation endpoints that are pinned to dedicated-eu-1. A subset of customers (acme-inc, beta-shop) report timeouts. Console shows queue growth and work-stealing throttles.

Aisha (oncall): Status page? Do we need to page sales/CS?

Priya (SRE): I'm flagging as P1 for now. CS: notifying tier-1 customers (AC) via status updates. Suggest immediate live mitigations: 1) enable burst capacity for dedicated-eu-1, 2) raise autoscale max replicas temporarily, 3) apply short-term per-customer rate limits for the heavy tenants, 4) route non-critical workloads off the pool (traffic shaping).

SRE-Bot: Suggested runbook steps found: `dedicated_pool_overload_v2` (link) -> steps 1-4 match Priya.

Aisha (oncall): I'll run burst toggle and bump autoscaler. Priya, can you craft rate-limit rules for the heavy tenants? Miguel, please prep for handoff in 30m.

Priya (SRE): On it. Proposing temporary rate-limit of 20 r/s per API key for acme-inc and 10 r/s for beta-shop, TTL 1h, with an emergency quota bump path if they escalate. Also propose disabling expensive post-processing (rerank) for those keys to reduce compute.

Aisha (oncall): Running burst enable command now (console + CLI fallback).

Aisha (oncall): ```
# CLI
rci pools toggle-burst --pool dedicated-eu-1 --enable true
# or via admin API
POST /api/v1/admin/pools/dedicated-eu-1/burst?enable=true
```

Aisha (oncall): CLI returned 200, burst enabled. Pool config: max_burst_instances=2, burst_window=300s.

Priya (SRE): Setting autoscaler max replicas: currently 12 -> increasing to 20. Applying now.

Aisha (oncall): ```
rci autoscale update --pool dedicated-eu-1 --max 20 --target_cpu 70
```

Aisha (oncall): Autoscaler accepted change, scaling policy updated. Triggering immediate scale-up request.

SRE-Bot: Scale-up job queued; expected node spin-up ~2.5m for GPU nodes (regional).

Priya (SRE): Implementing rate-limit rules now. Using traffic-control service.

Priya (SRE): ```
# add rate-limit for acme-inc
tcctl limits create --customer acme-inc --pool dedicated-eu-1 --rate 20r/s --burst 40 --ttl 3600
# add rate-limit for beta-shop
tcctl limits create --customer beta-shop --pool dedicated-eu-1 --rate 10r/s --burst 20 --ttl 3600
# disable rerank for those keys
tcctl feature-toggle set --customer acme-inc --feature rerank --enabled false --ttl 3600
tcctl feature-toggle set --customer beta-shop --feature rerank --enabled false --ttl 3600
```

Priya (SRE): Rules accepted. Applied with immediate effect.

Aisha (oncall): Also routing non-critical routes to hosted fallback for 15% of traffic to shed load. Applying routing policy change.

Aisha (oncall): ```
# route 15% of /v1/embeddings traffic to hosted-fallback pool
rci routing update --pool dedicated-eu-1 --route "/v1/embeddings" --fallback hosted-global-embeddings --weight 15
```

Aisha (oncall): Routing change applied. Monitoring latency and error-rate.

Priya (SRE): Quick customer impact assessment: acme-inc saw ~40% of requests throttled by new rule; error rate down to 6%, median latency dropping from 1.4s -> 0.9s. Overall 5xx rate for pool down from 12% -> 4% after burst + rate limits.

Miguel (oncall-2): Joining. Got handoff in 20m. Anything you'd like me to own for the next hour?

Aisha (oncall): Please own monitoring dashboard and CS comms. I will keep running scaling watch and coordinate with infra to confirm new instances healthy. Priya to own per-customer rule rollback plan.

Priya (SRE): Rollback plan: when pool 5xx <1% and queue depth stable for 10m, revert rate limits and re-enable rerank for each customer incrementally (5 min windows). If any customer escalates, we have an emergency path to raise their quota via `tcctl limits update --customer X --rate Y` and notify CS.

Aisha (oncall): Infra reports two new GPU nodes provisioning; expected join ~3m. Once nodes join, autoscaler will rebalance.

SRE-Bot: Incident timeline recorded. Notifying status page: "Partial degradation for Dedicated EU pool; mitigation in progress".

Priya (SRE): Observability: attaching sample log snippets (sanitized):
```
2026-04-12T03:12:01Z pool=dedicated-eu-1 req_id=abc123 status=503 reason=upstream_queue_overflow
2026-04-12T03:13:44Z pool=dedicated-eu-1 req_id=def456 status=200 latency_ms=920 model=redwood-alpha
```

Aisha (oncall): Good. I'll watch for healthy joins. If scale-up stalls, fallback is to temporarily disable non-critical features globally (image-ops, rerank) and consider diverting more traffic to hosted.

Priya (SRE): Confirming feature-disable list prepared: [`rerank`, `semantic-similarity-postprocess`, `extra-hydration`]. We should only disable globally if we see no improvement in 10m.

Aisha (oncall): 10m check: current pool 5xx = 3.8%, queue depth trending down. New nodes at 80% join completed. Autoscaler created 5 additional replicas; CPU usage falling.

Miguel (oncall-2): I'll take over monitoring and CS updates at T+35m. Aisha, want to do handoff now?

Aisha (oncall): Handoff in 5m. Current mitigations in place: burst enabled, max replicas 20, per-customer short-term rate-limits applied, 15% hosted routing fallback, rerank disabled for heavy customers. Impact: partial degradation for some tenants but overall system stabilizing.

Priya (SRE): Re-checking metrics: acme-inc error rate down to 1.5%, beta-shop 2.1%. Overall pool 5xx ~1.8%. Queue depth normalized.

Aisha (oncall): Ok handing off to Miguel. Miguel, please continue ramp-down of mitigations once stable: remove hosted routing fallback after 10m stable, revert per-customer rerank toggles in staged windows, then reduce max-replicas back to baseline over 30m.

Miguel (oncall-2): Taking over. I'll post a postmortem stub later with timeline and root-cause investigations. Also will follow up with Capacity team to ensure autoscaler thresholds/boot times are tuned to avoid future manual toggles.

SRE-Bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next steps: RCA, capacity tuning, improve auto-scaling heuristics, consider predictive burst pre-warming.

Aisha (oncall): Thanks team. Closing active paging to me. Miguel will continue. :white_check_mark:

Miguel (oncall-2): Noted. I'll keep the thread updated and coordinate postmortem.
